_about: Wilhelm Sigmund Teuffel (1820-1878): A History of Roman Literature, tr. Wilhelm Wagner (London, 1873), 2 vols. Round dy (2026-10-23), raw IA: the Schwabe revision in G. C. W. Warr's translation from the fifth German edition (1891-92, 2 vols), a different translation from Wagner's 1873 one already held. Warr's name is garbled on both title pages ('GEOEGE C. W. WAEE'), so the translator is recorded under _identity_checked rather than as a gate claim.
